newsitem.title: TURKMENISTAN: Turkmen capital to undergo $200 mln modernisation.
newsitem.headline: Turkmen capital to undergo $200 mln modernisation.

text.p: Turkey's Mensel construction company is to carry out a $200 million modernisation of infrastructure in Turkmenistan's capital Ashgabat, the official Turkmen-Press news agency said on Monday.

Mensel will update the city's water and drainage systems along with its telephone, electricity and gas distribution networks, mostly in the old city. The agency said also 100 km (62 miles) of roads and pavements in the city would meet international standards by the end of the year.
Cash for the work would come from a $200 million credit from the Japanese government, the agency said.

A rash of glittering five-star hotels and a large new presidential palace have appeared in recently, part of Turkmen President Saparmurat Niyazov's drive to smarten up the drab, Soviet-built city on the edge of the Kara Kum desert.
Mensel is already building a 32,000-seat, $26 million sports stadium in the capital of this energy-rich nation of four million.
